in_sanskrit.name: Samsuddin
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Protector of the Universe
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Samsuddin एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Samsuddin is a combination of two words: 'Sam' meaning protector and 'Suddin' meaning pure. It is believed that a person named Samsuddin is a protector of the universe and is pure at heart.
